notes.title: April Update
notes.notes:
[h1]This update introduces a new mechanic besides new improvements to the game.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38013061/0b70b04e59dfcf265cc0631a0d68f7722fc0152a.png[/img]

[h2][b]1[/b][b]- Added a new mechanic.[/b][/h2]
[h3]This new mechanic gives the boss a shield mid-fight that reduces any damage to the boss, to destroy its shield you'll have to use your electricity ability.[/h3]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V-mDm0OsHaA

[b]2[/b]- Added FPS limiter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38013061/a62a04266c1858a3314d3f8253198e318cfb3d1d.png[/img]

[b]3[/b]- Added [b]Horizontal[/b] and [b]Verticle[/b] mouse slider.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38013061/a8eee7a1a36225be774829f59554815d63a1658b.png[/img]

[b]4[/b]- Added a tutorial for the new mechanic.
[b]5[/b]- Added more explanation for the re-fight tutorial for each boss after you defeat them.
[b]6[/b]- Added effect when shooting the gravity void.
[b]7[/b]- Improved the health bar for the bosses.
[b]8[/b]- Improved the tips menu.
[b]9[/b]- Improved the tutorial a bit.
[b]10[/b]- Improved camera movement in shooting, dashing, and running.
[b]11[/b]- Improve The firewall gate in mobs encounters.
[b]12[/b]- Reduced the blur while dashing and running a bit.
[b]13[/b]- Reduced machine gun fire rate.
[b]14[/b]- Fixed shooting, dodging, aim down sight, taking damage when the tutorial starts.
[b]15[/b]- Fixed the tutorial boss could be stuck in its 3rd phase.




[b]Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/GmUvHBd9gm]discord server[/url][/b]
